prompts.front:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: individual orthographic character turnaround image for Tripo multiview reconstruction. SAME adult female low-poly Azure WWII fantasy soldier as reference: blue faceted helmet with ivory center stripe, short solid dark brown bob, extremely minimal face, blue heavy coat and pale blue collar/cuffs, charcoal chest plate and shoulder plates, olive webbing with two hip pouches, navy trousers, chunky black boots/gloves. Small four-white-diamond emblem on character's LEFT shoulder only (viewer right in front view). Preserve the reference's shapes, colours, proportions and simple large flat polygon surfaces. No added gear or weapons, no texture noise, no realistic detail. White background, neutral even light, no shadow, no text or labels.
POSE LOCK: symmetric A-pose, arms straight 30 degrees out from vertical, hands empty relaxed, legs equally spaced, toes straight forward parallel, knees straight, weight balanced. Head and gaze aligned rigidly with torso, nose points in same direction as chest and toes; no head tilt or turn. Pure orthographic camera level, no perspective, no three-quarter view, no camera tilt. Full body centered in a 1024x1536 portrait canvas, helmet crown at y=60, soles at y=1470; identical scale and vertical positions across the set. Belt at approximately y=565. Both hands and boots fully inside frame. Do not crop.
THIS IMAGE: exact straight-on FRONT view. Correct the reference's slightly turned head and torso so both eyes, ears, shoulders and boots are symmetric in projection; nose and helmet stripe precisely on the vertical centreline. Face looks directly forward toward camera. Keep the design, change only the camera/pose to a true front orthographic. Single character only.

Image 1 is the LEFT profile master and must define the EXACT silhouette, proportions, pose, vertical landmark positions, camera projection and scale. Image 2 is FRONT reference for design only. Result must look exactly like the HORIZONTAL MIRROR of image 1's body and head silhouette, facing IMAGE RIGHT, with one intentional anatomical difference: near right shoulder plate is plain charcoal with NO white emblem. Do not make a three-quarter view. Only one eye visible, face nose chest boot toes all point exactly RIGHT. No visible front helmet stripe except any physically justified tiny edge; left master has no visible stripe so match that. No far-side pouch sticking out; all far limbs and equipment precisely overlap as in image1. Arms/hands and legs in SAME projected pose and exact heights as image1. Same helmet crown y42 and sole baseline about y1468 in same 1024x1536 canvas, silhouette horizontally mirrored around image center. Preserve same blue heavy coat, olive straps and pouch, chest plate depth, dark hair, blank minimal face, angular boots/gloves, large low-poly facets. Plain white background, even flat light, no ground shadow or text. One full-body character.
